items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects the basic properties of the collection of sieves on an object: it is a set, partially ordered by inclusion, closed under unions and intersections, contains a sieve generated by a given family, and the maximal and minimal sieves are the representable one and the empty one (statement lines 11119-11135). The proof is a complete verification: the collection is exhibited as a subset of a product of powersets (proof lines 11138-11143); the ordering and the unions and intersections are defined componentwise (proof lines 11146-11155); the generated sieve is defined as a union of images (proof lines 11157-11160); and the author records that the last two assertions are obvious (proof lines 11162-11163). The non-formal content is the construction of the generated sieve. The claim is H1: several short verifications.
